text: Why choose to study this program? This program is offered by School of Aeronautics Science and Engineering of Beihang University, which cultivated many professional in aeronautics field and achieved many scientific research. Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering ranks No. 1 among the whole country. Main Courses Descriptive Geometry, Engineering Materials, Mechanical Drawing, Mechanics of Materials, Theoretical Mechanics, Fundamental Physics, Manufacturing Technology etc. Main practical teaching links: computer experiment courses, computer training, course design and production practice and graduation design, the general practice teaching of not less than 30 weeks. Major experiments: complete at least one of the professional direction of a group of professional laboratory, etc Internship and Career Development Through 4 years study, graduates can master and basic knowledge of math, mechanics, know basic theory of aircraft engineering and general structure design and strength analysis of aircraft. Graduates of this major could work on aircraft general design, structure design and research, structure strength analysis and test, and become advanced professional engineering technicians and research person on general mechanical design and manufacturing.
